svg.title: CreatorRoom system architecture
svg.desc: A creator uses Slack. A locally self-hosted Switch server routes requests and review handoffs to two custom agents in a single Node.js application. The agents call Anthropic Claude. Switch persists room data in PostgreSQL; CreatorRoom stores durable jobs, immutable content packs and approvals in SQLite with local source files. A React web workspace uploads transcripts and previews content, with YouTube IFrame navigation.

g.text: A creator’s editorial team, connected by Switch.
One source → collaborative drafting → source review → creator approval → a usable content pack
One Slack app · two agent names
Fastify API · one Node.js process · two agent clients
Clickable sections · transcript search · source evidence · revision history
THE CREATOR HAS THE FINAL SAY
Chapter buttons seek the embedded video. Native YouTube chapter access is not required.
Brand marks identify their respective technologies.
